newsitem.title: USA: IBM, Prudential in $340 million service deal.
newsitem.headline: IBM, Prudential in $340 million service deal.

text.p: An International Business Machines Corp. subsidiary will provide information technology services to two units of Prudential Insurance Co. of America in a five-year deal worth $340 million, the companies said Thursday.
The agreement also allows the IBM subsidiary, Integrated Systems Solutions Corp., to offer jobs to about 900 Prudential employees, the companies said.
Integrated Systems will provide maintenance for some Prudential systems used by its individual insurance and money management groups.
IBM's stock fell $1 to $123.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
